subject: Changing legend labels for point sizes scaled with a tranformation

messages.author: 55862ed2ee4180f3
messages.subject: Changing legend labels for point sizes scaled with a tranformation
parts:
Hi,

I would like scale points on a log transformed scale, but then have the legend text present the original units.  For example

data <- data.frame(x = runif(20), y = runif(20), value = rlnorm(20,10,5))
 ggplot(data = data, aes( x = x, y = y) )+ geom_point(aes(size = log(value)))

In the legend I would like to have labels 10, 100, 1000, 100000 etc.

How would I control this?

Thanks,

Matt
